BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to regulating liquified petroleum gas; adding a newchapter to Title 19 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The definitions in this section applythroughout this chapter unless the context clearly requires otherwise. (1) "Container" means all vessels, such as tanks, portablecylinders, or drums, with a water capacity equal to or greater than twohundred thirtynine pounds, used for transporting or storing liquefiedpetroleum gas. (2) "Cylinder" means a portable container that is constructed toUnited States department of transportation specifications that has lessthan two hundred thirtynine pounds of water capacity and that iscapable of storing liquified petroleum gas. (3) "Liquefied petroleum gas" means any hydrocarbon or mixture ofhydrocarbons composed predominantly of propane, propyleme, butanes,normal butane, isobutane, or butylenes. (4) "Person" means a natural person, corporation, partnership,firm, receiver, trustee, or any organized group of persons.

(1) A person, other than the owner of aliquified petroleum gas container or a person authorized in writing bythe owner, may not: (a) Fill or refill a liquified petroleum gas container withliquified petroleum gas or any other gas or compound; or (b) Deface, erase, obliterate, cover up, or otherwise remove orconceal any name, mark, initial, or device on a liquified petroleum gas container. (2) This section does not apply to cylinders. (3) A violation of this chapter is a class 1 civil infraction underchapter 7.80 RCW.
Sections 1 and 2 of this act constitute anew chapter in Title 19 RCW.
